versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-viral-replicate:

- Automatically dissects viral short videos into aligned "visual + transcript + subtitle" timelines using ffmpeg, whisper, and OCR.
- Supports direct video upload or share links (Douyin, Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, WeChat Video, YouTube, etc.), with auto-download and processing.
- Zero-configuration: automatically creates venv, installs all dependencies, and uses bundled ffmpeg.
- Generates actionable, template-based creative rewrites and analyzes viral video structure.
- Outputs structured JSON for downstream use, and provides troubleshooting and tuning tips.
